import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Look for strong individual associations
    strongest = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        y1 = feats.x[feats.y == 1, i]
        y0 = feats.x[feats.y == 0, i]
        if len(y1) > 0 and len(y0) > 0:
            tstat, pval = stats.ttest_ind(y1, y0, equal_var=False)
            if pval < 0.001:
                effect = abs(tstat) * (1 - pval)  # Effect strength measure
                strongest.append((fid, effect))
    
    strongest.sort(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
    
    # Select top drivers (limit to 4 to satisfy constraint)
    drivers = tuple([fid for fid, _ in strongest[:4]])
    
    # Select columns for regression (limit to 8 to keep model small)
    columns = []
    for fid, effect in strongest:
        if len(columns) >= 8:  # Limit columns to keep model small
            break
        # Skip if too correlated with existing columns
        is_correlated = False
        for col_fid in columns:
            col_idx = feats.column(col_fid)
            fid_idx = feats.column(fid)
            corr = abs(np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, fid_idx], feats.x[:, col_idx])[0, 1])
            if corr > 0.7:
                is_correlated = True
                break
        if not is_correlated:
            columns.append(fid)
    
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=tuple(columns), products=(), loadings={})
